blocks.instruction: HELLO → hands down naturally → HOME. No deliberate READY wait between words. Return to neutral after HOME; keep recording about 3 seconds, then STOP.
HELLO → HOME. Keep hands in signing space; no deliberate READY wait or hands-down reset. Return to neutral only after HOME; allow about 3 seconds, then STOP.
HELLO → HELLO as two distinct executions. Keep hands in signing space; no deliberate READY wait. Return to neutral only after the second HELLO; allow about 3 seconds, then STOP.
Sign HELLO once, then hold its final position about 5 seconds without a second sign. Return naturally, allow about 3 seconds, then STOP. Reviewer marks sign end and hold interval separately.
Move or reposition your hands/body normally for about 5 seconds, without intending any sign. Return naturally, allow about 3 seconds, then STOP.
